messages:
elaine: Quick check — webinar goes live next Wed 10am PT. Need X + LinkedIn scheduling, a 30s teaser clip, and the short thread copy. Who can own assets?
matt: I can grab slides and export a 30s clip from the demo section. will need a timestamp marker.
ravi: I can draft the X thread variants: long-thread (story + benchmark) and short-thread (TL;DR + CTA). tagging @matt for clip timing.
jamie: I can handle LinkedIn post copy and pick the hero image. prefer 1 hero image + 1 carousel slide.
elaine: Awesome. For routing — make sure the webinar form has utm_source=twitter_x and utm_source=linkedin when posting so HubSpot maps leads to inbound_webinar queue.
jamie: noted. who will add UTM params in scheduler? We should standardize UTM set: utm_campaign=webinar_march26, utm_medium=social, utm_source={channel}
matt: I will export the 30s clip and a 15s cut for stories. ETA EOD today.
ravi: Draft copies: 

- Variant A (long): "We benchmarked 3 open models on latency & cost. Results you can ship with -> join our webinar next Wed. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=twitter_x&utm_campaign=webinar_march26" 
- Variant B (short): "Webinar next Wed: faster, cheaper LLM inference. 30 mins. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=twitter_x" 

Which should we A/B on X first?
elaine: Let's run A/B on X for the top-performing time slot, and use Variant B on LinkedIn (more concise). Also include a benchmark snapshot image in the X long thread.
jamie: For LinkedIn we're going with Variant B + carousel of 3 slides: problem, result, CTA. I'll drop image sizes in the assets channel.
elaine: Posting cadence idea: staggered push day-of + day-after + reminder 2 days before. Proposed times (PT): 9:30am, 12:30pm, 5:00pm. Thoughts?
ravi: Sounds good. For X run the A/B at 12:30pm (higher engagement historically). Use 9:30am as teaser (clip), 12:30pm A/B thread, 5pm reminder.
jamie: LinkedIn: 9:30am (carousel), 2pm (reminder), 4pm (last chance). I'll queue those in Pulse scheduler.
elaine: Asset checklist:
- 30s clip (matt) [mp4]
- 15s cut (matt) [mp4]
- benchmark snapshot image (design) [png]
- 3 LinkedIn carousel slides (jamie) [png]
- X long thread copy + short copy (ravi)
- UTM mapping documented (elaine)

Can design turn benchmark snapshot by 4pm?
matt: I can hand off raw frames by 2pm. tagging @design for final.
jamie: I'll create the pulse job and add UTMs. who will review copy before scheduling?
ravi: please review, I can post updated drafts here by 3pm.
elaine: I'll do final copy review at 3:30pm. If everything green we schedule by 4pm.
scheduler-bot: Scheduled posts precheck:
```
Channel: X
Post 1: 2026-03-25T16:30:00Z (teaser clip)
Post 2A: 2026-03-25T19:30:00Z (X Thread Variant A)
Post 2B: 2026-03-25T19:30:00Z (X Thread Variant B)
Post 3: 2026-03-25T00:00:00Z (reminder)
Channel: LinkedIn
Post 1: 2026-03-25T16:30:00Z (carousel)
Post 2: 2026-03-25T18:00:00Z (reminder)
```

scheduler-bot: NOTE: A/B pairs are queued but will only publish Variant A or B per experiment flag. Confirm 'publish_experiment=true' to go live.
elaine: Confirming publish_experiment=true for X.
jamie: Confirmed. I'll watch HubSpot mapping and SDR queue. tagging @sales-ops to double-check inbound mapping.
matt: Clip uploaded to /assets/launch/webinar_march26/clip30.mp4
ravi: Drafts posted in this thread: "Variant A" and "Variant B" — feel free to leave inline edits.
elaine: Great work team. Follow-up: after first post, monitor replies and thread engagement — assign someone to 30m monitoring rotation. can @ravi own first window?
ravi: Yep I got the 12:30–1:30pm window.
elaine: Perfect. We'll do a quick wrap tomorrow morning with initial engagement metrics.
